objectives: Introduction of cockpit panels layout, displays and indications
Introduce designed eye position and adjust seat position, side stick and thrust lever grips
Introduce pre-flight crew routine task
Introduce Flight Control Unit Panel set-up procedures
Practice takeoff roll directional control, rotation, liftoff techniques
Introduce glass cockpit, EFIS display, PFD/ND, engine display scan and crosscheck
Introduce Airline’s jet airplane flying characteristics
Introduce Airline’s jet airplane handling of climb, level off, turns and descent.
Practice crew coordination standard call-out, Challenge & response
Practice basic ATC communication, use of communication and audio devices
Introduce and apply basic operation procedures and Checklist
notes: Brief cockpit layout, panels, PFD, ND, FCU (EFIS) controls and indications
Review ILS approach configuration, procedures and calls
Demo the Takeoff roll, rotate, liftoff and climb out
Demo visual pattern, full stop landing

subItems: Simulator safety
Seat position, eyes position adjustment, rudder pedal and feet position
Side stick griping, Thrust levers control
Communication system (Head set. interphone, VHF, COM/ACP panel)
FCU initial setting
Simplified cockpit preparation
ATIS & ATC Clearance
SID Briefing
Thrust manually set to approximately Flex N1 for takeoff
Direction control
Takeoff rotate rate and pitch attitude controls
Liftoff and climb out
Thrust reduction to CL (then disengage A/THR) and acceleration for cleanup, climb and maintain 3,000 ft, 250 kias.
Standard calls
Control input and responses on pitch, roll and yaw
Turns and roll out
Decelerate and accelerate while maintain level flight
Practice instrument scan and cross check

maneuvers: Climb / descend, level off, thrust change

maneuvers.text: Practice approach and configure landing configuration for final descent (Not ILS approach)
subItems: IP Demo first
TLA IDLE to decelerate to Green Dot speed, extend Flaps 1, 2, start descend at 1,000 fpm, L/G down, 750 fpm, Flaps 3, Flaps full, Vapp
Notice the pitch attitude and thrust change for different configuration
(Cont’d above maneuver) Level off at 500 ft, keep Vapp in landing configuration.
IP Demo, first, the approach control technique, on vertical path, center line alignment, flare technique,
Freeze Sim at 200’, 100’, threshold to show the sight vision of the height and runway visual references.
Review lesson SIM 1 lesson objectives
Read FCOM Indication and Display, to know the PFD’s indications
Read FCOM flight control section
Read RCKH Jeppesen charts
Review TO and climb procedures and standard calls
Review FCOM, FCTM takeoff and landing techniques
Review ILS configuration, procedures and standard callouts

dclPdc.title: CLEARANCE
dclPdc.content:
“Smart Cat 301 is cleared to Porch DME fix, via Kaohsiung 1 radar Departure, climb and
maintain FL150. Departure frequency 124.7, squawk 2601”

datis.title: DEP ATIS
datis.content:
